digest.component_or_area: Jira reconcile bridge, comment deduplication layer
propositions: A silently-returning guard (`is_comment_mapped`) on the primary dedup path was inert in production because the `comment_ids` map was never populated, from the feature's first run until the fix was applied.

The secondary body-equality dedup fallback absorbed enough traffic to mask the primary skip's failure, causing a partial-success symptom (22/25 short comments deduped, 1/40 rich-formatted) rather than obvious total failure.

The test suite covers both shores of the dedup path (apply-side recording, differ-side skipping) but does not cross the seam between them; all tests pass with `is_comment_mapped` hard-wired to `False` because each layer seeds the invariant the other layer establishes.

The `comment_ids` map key first appeared empty in production 2026-08-15 and remained at zero until the fix landed 2026-08-20, making this a never-worked defect with a 6-day escape window, not a regression.

No existing plan-review or code-review criterion at the time of 789c's passage addressed silent fail-open guards on correctness-critical paths; the applicable rubric was added post-escape after nine recorded instances.

An in-process reconciler invariant alert—emitted when outbound comments are successfully posted but `comment_ids` gains no entries—would have surfaced the inert guard in production without CI coupling or new review criteria.
